{{Quote|Captain, uh, my scopes just picked up a ghost image in our sensor wake.''"<br />"''Probably another glitch like that false biosignature we saw in the cargo hold earlier.|The [[1729's co-pilot|co-pilot]] of ''[[1729]]'' and the captain|<ref name="BH" />}}
An individual was the '''captain''' of ''[[1729]]'', a [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] for the [[Desolation Alley]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. Their [[1729's co-pilot|co-pilot]] noticed an anomaly in the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] wake which the captain assumed would be a glitch, as the sensors of ''1729'' had malfunctioned before. After checking again, the co-pilot agreed that it was a glitch, but the anomaly was actually [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] using ''1729'' to slip [[Jaster's Legacy|his ship]] past the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] surrounding Desolation Alley.<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
''1729{{'s}}'' captain's only appearance has been in a cutscene in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', in which they were voiced by [[Mel Fair]].
